mapper.sql: select c.id, c.note_id, c.parent_id, c.reply_to_user_id, c.user_id, c.content, c.status, c.create_time, u.nick_name as user_name, u.avatar, ru.nick_name as reply_to_user_name from note_comment c left join sys_user u on c.user_id = u.user_id left join sys_user ru on c.reply_to_user_id = ru.user_id
mapper.select: where c.parent_id = #{parentId} and c.status = 1 order by c.create_time asc

WITH RECURSIVE comment_tree AS ( -- 基础查询：根评论的直接子回复 SELECT c.* FROM note_comment c WHERE c.parent_id = #{parentId} AND c.status = 1 UNION ALL -- 递归查询：子回复的子回复 SELECT c.* FROM note_comment c INNER JOIN comment_tree ct ON c.parent_id = ct.id WHERE c.status = 1 ) SELECT ct.id, ct.note_id, ct.parent_id, ct.reply_to_user_id, ct.user_id, ct.content, ct.status, ct.create_time, u.nick_name as user_name, u.avatar, ru.nick_name as reply_to_user_name FROM comment_tree ct LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON ct.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user ru ON ct.reply_to_user_id = ru.user_id ORDER BY ct.create_time ASC
